deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - MCM004 Medicare Indiv - R6 Period (202511-202604)

detail_statements: Out of 729,449 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by 5.57% and PMPM ratio increased by 25.85% for R6 period.
In NJ, out of 729,449 total claims (for R6), 537,298 (73.66%) were NPAR, resulting in $110,778,923.90 in OON payments.

In NJ, out of 50,220 total NPAR claims for Provider PUBLIC PARTNERSHIPS, LLC under the DSNP HMO product, 0.03% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In NJ, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
Out of 423,746 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by 121.70% and PMPM ratio decreased by -11.40% for R6 period.
In FL, out of 423,746 total claims (for R6), 383,674 (90.54%) were NPAR, resulting in $59,708,714.82 in OON payments.

In FL, out of 3,201 total NPAR claims for Provider LABORATORY CORPORATION OF AMERICA under the DSNP HMO product, 3.81% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In FL, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
Out of 413,109 total claims, NPAR claims count percentage increased by -45.48% and PMPM ratio decreased by -63.64% for R6 period.
In VA, out of 413,109 total claims (for R6), 372,303 (90.12%) were NPAR, resulting in $81,834,967.65 in OON payments.

In VA, out of 3,988 total NPAR claims for Provider HOPE IN HOME CARE LLC under the DSNP HMO product, 0.11% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In VA, no IDR-flagged claims were identified during the R6 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.

BEN TAUB HOSPITAL shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.

DRG 871 (Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours with MCC) and DRG 291 (Heart Failure and Shock with MCC) are the top two DRGs by NPAR claim volume for BEN TAUB HOSPITAL, accounting for approximately 17.7% of total mapped OON claims. A total of 39 DRGs are needed to reach 80% of mapped OON reimbursements.
